name: Coarse Mesh Traversal with Dual-Ray Culling
definition: A traversal algorithm for a coarse tetrahedral mesh that uses two rays (one with front-face culling, one with back-face culling) to determine the ray's position relative to the coarse mesh elements, handling non-convex shapes and holes.
summary: Coarse Mesh Traversal with Dual-Ray Culling determines ray entry and exit distances in non-convex tetrahedral meshes by tracing two rays with opposite face culling, solving robustness issues that single-ray methods face with complex geometries.
